verdict.rationale: The API docs say Cal.com issues separate test-mode and live-mode secret keys (prefixes `cal_` vs `cal_live_`), which points to a first-party test mode distinct from production. Beyond the key prefix, nothing documents how that test mode behaves or that it is isolated from production data. Self-hosting Cal.diy is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of a sandbox environment or base URL, confirmation that test-mode data is isolated from production (no real bookings, emails or calendar writes), how test data is seeded or reset, test-mode support for the MCP server and CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Test mode secret keys have the prefix `cal_` and live mode secret keys have the prefix `cal_live_`.
